One of several throne rooms located in the [[Imperial Palace/Legends|Imperial Palace]] which served as one of the seats of power for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], this throne room was the setting for the final acts of the [[Anti-Sith conspiracy]] masterminded by [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Trachta]]. Unlike the [[Imperial Throne Room|main palace throne room]], this throne room was differentiated by its simple layout and sparse interior.

==History==
Located within the Imperial Palace, this throne room was constructed at some point between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] and [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]. During his rule, Palpatine used this throne room for private meetings with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|advisors]] and officials of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire 1: Betrayal, Part 1">[[Empire 1|''Empire'' 1]]</ref>

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], the Emperor summoned [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] Trachta to the throne room where he preceded to tell the Grand Moff he would be requiring a detachment to join him when he traveled to the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] to meet with [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. Palpatine then proceeded to inform Trachta of his plans to [[Dissolution of the Imperial Senate/Legends|dissolve the Imperial Senate]]. Realizing the perfect time to spring his coup d'état, Trachta inquired whether Vader was to accompany him, Palpatine informed the Grand Moff to attend to only what concerned him. Later, Palpatine summoned Darth Vader to the throne room and ordered the present [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|guards]] and advisor out so he could speak privately with Vader. Alone, Vader was charged with the task of locating and dealing with a reported [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] welding [[Dargulli Dark Jedi|vigilante]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire 1: Betrayal, Part 1" />

Several days later, the final stages of the coup took place under command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kadir (Moff)|Kadir]] who had assumed control after the assassinations of Trachta and Grand Moff [[Bartam]].<ref name="Star Wars: Empire 3: Betrayal, Part 3">[[Empire 3|''Empire'' 3]]</ref> With fellow co-conspirator [[Gauer]], they entered the throne room with their cadre of special programmed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Just as the troopers aimed their blasters at Palpatine, his Royal Guards leaped from hiding in the room's drapes and engaged Kadir and the stormtroopers in battle. After a while, Palpatine killed the troopers with a great unleashing of [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]], sparing only Kadir and his guards. Failing to then shoot the Emperor and being attacked with more lightning, Palpatine continued to inform Kadir that he had been impressed with the young Moff's supposed masterminding of the plot but that his claim of Vader's death, the Dark Lord was still alive.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire 4: Betrayal, Part 4">[[Empire 4|''Empire'' 4]]</ref> Returning to his throne and activating a [[Holocamera/Legends|holocam]], the two proceeded to watch Vader eliminate the remainder of Trachta's stormtroopers and fellow co-conspirator [[Dezsetes]]. Palpatine then killed Kadir with an attack of powerful lightning.

Later, Vader came to the throne room and spoke with his Master of the failed coup and informed him he had successfully accomplished his mission to Dargulli.<ref name="Star Wars: Empire 4: Betrayal, Part 4" /> Emperor Palpatine then informed his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] that his next mission would be assisting Grand Moff Tarkin in the final preparations of the Death Star.
